title: Sebastian and the Cover
premise: Dominic Yarrow, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve of Flight 447, has survived on insomnia, routine, and the fiction that the accident was an accident. When a stranger named Sebastian repays a favor she never performed—delivering a ledger that proves the crash was engineered—she is pulled into a conspiracy reaching into her own agency. As she and Sebastian trace the plot toward a second, larger 'accident' scheduled to bury the evidence, Dominic discovers the man who signed off on the original cover-up is her mentor, and that her family was targeted because her father was about to blow the whistle. The novel ends with Dominic choosing love over the institutional duty that consumed her: she exposes the truth at devastating personal cost, stops the second crash with minutes to spare, and finally sleeps through the night—beside the man who dragged her into the light.
about_author: Oscar Zhou is a former aviation-safety analyst who left the field after a decade of near-misses he was never allowed to write about. He lives near a small regional airport, where he still watches takeoffs and counts the rows.

chapters.title: Row Twelve
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Insomnia, ritual, and the anniversary visit to the crash site establish her grief and her obsessive re-investigation of Flight 447. Emotional beat: grief calcified into routine, and the first crack in it—a detail in the wreckage photos she can no longer unsee.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He watches Dominic for days before delivering the ledger, repaying a debt owed to her father. Emotional beat: guilt and calculation; Sebastian is a man paying interest on someone else's sin.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She verifies the ledger's authenticity and realizes the 'accident' was a controlled decompression. Emotional beat: vertigo—the foundation of her grief rewrites itself, and rage replaces mourning.

chapters.title: The Quiet Man
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Flashback to how he became the conspiracy's courier and why he turned. Emotional beat: shame sharpened into resolve; he chose Dominic because she's the only one who won't stop.

chapters.title: Chain of Custody
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She traces the ledger through maintenance records to a falsified inspection signed by her mentor, Alan Voss. Emotional beat: betrayal; the man who taught her to love the truth forged it.

chapters.title: Two Coffees
chapters.summary: Dominic and Sebastian meet properly, trading information in a diner. Sparks and suspicion. Emotional beat: wary alliance—two insomniacs recognizing each other's damage.

chapters.title: What Voss Signed
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He breaks into a records annex and finds a second document: a scheduled 'event' at Meridian Air's safety summit. Emotional beat: dread—the pattern is repeating, bigger.

chapters.title: The Watchers
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She notices surveillance—her apartment, her office. Someone inside the agency is feeding her movements to the conspirators. Emotional beat: paranoia closing in; nowhere is invisible anymore.

chapters.title: Debrief
chapters.summary: Dominic confronts Voss obliquely over drinks; he deflects with fatherly warmth and a veiled threat. Emotional beat: the horror of being gaslit by someone she loved like family.

chapters.title: The Ledger's Gap
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Pages are missing from the ledger—the name of who ordered the crash. Emotional beat: frustration and fear that the trail dies before justice does.

chapters.title: Her Father's Desk
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She searches her late father's belongings and finds his own whistleblower draft, proving he died for the same document she now holds. Emotional beat: inheritance—she is finishing his sentence.

chapters.title: Safe House
chapters.summary: Sebastian and Dominic go dark after an attempt on her life. In hiding, walls come down; he tells her about the crash he caused by silence. Emotional beat: love taking root in the wreckage of trust.

chapters.title: The Passenger Manifest
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She decodes the missing pages: the order came from within the airline's board—and the summit flight carries the entire oversight committee. Emotional beat: clarity with a clock attached.

chapters.title: Voss's Confession
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. He confronts Voss, who admits the cover-up and reveals the second attack is designed to kill him too—cleanup. Emotional beat: pity for a corrupted man; Voss is a warning of what Dominic could become.

chapters.title: Countermand
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She tries to go through channels and is suspended, her access revoked, her file quietly rewritten. Emotional beat: the institution devouring its own; duty and truth fully severed.

chapters.title: Forty-Eight Hours
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The pair plans to stop the flight with no authority, no allies, and a leak they haven't found. Emotional beat: grim commitment—love against duty made literal.

chapters.title: The Leak
chapters.summary: Dominic identifies her colleague Dana as the informant—coerced, not corrupt. Emotional beat: mercy over vengeance; Dominic chooses to turn the leak instead of burning her.

chapters.title: Meridian
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Infiltration of the summit; the sabotage mechanism is confirmed aboard the committee's charter. Emotional beat: terror at close range—the 'accident' is elegant, invisible, and nearly ready.

chapters.title: Grounded
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Using Dana's access, she triggers a maintenance hold on the charter; the conspirators scramble to override. Emotional beat: defiance—the invisible woman makes herself impossible to ignore.

chapters.title: Row Twelve, Again
chapters.summary: Climax. Dominic's POV. Aboard the held aircraft, she faces the saboteur and Voss's enforcer; Sebastian is wounded buying her the seconds she needs. She broadcasts the evidence mid-standoff as federal agents arrive. Emotional beat: grief weaponized into witness; she saves the plane her family couldn't be saved from.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Hearings, arrests, Voss's quiet resignation and quieter arrest; the ledger becomes public record. Emotional beat: justice that feels less like victory than exhaustion—and the first honest breath.

chapters.title: Sleeping Through the Night
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Months later: a memorial finally tells the truth, her father's name is cleared, and she wakes at dawn next to Sebastian, having slept. Emotional beat: resolution—love chosen over duty, grief given somewhere to rest.
